scope: Only the assigned shared exercise download helper and regression test; no book/site/source/PDF/package edits, Git/network/browser/publishing actions.

contract.definitionVersion: Current content edition, still exact-match validated
contract.exerciseEdition: Optional explicit strict numeric semver equal to or older than current content edition; absent field retains original current-edition routes
contract.callerApproval: Caller provides already-approved definition/artifact pins; book release validator certifies historical approval and matches the retainedExercise contract. Shared helper does not invent that approval.

coverage: Retained numeric older editions preserve exact paths, hashes, bytes and row order
Invalid or future editions, including precision-sensitive components, fail
Older routes without explicit selection fail
Another book/edition, traversal, wrong artifact path fail
Missing/mismatched package pins, changed measured size/bytes fail
Selection changes are bound by the approved definition hash
All original definition/size/hash/symlink/unsafe-path failure guards retained

boundedDiffReview.notes: Existing download validation below selected-prefix computation is byte-identical. Existing no-definition and own-edition behavior remains intact.
